title: Bake-off (validators): deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
question: Who stands behind NEAR’s validators? Make me a fresh flower with their backers, not an existing one.
note: A real run on NEAR AI Cloud (T060), kept with the signature each completion got. A hash or link the model copied from a tool result is written as a reference to that result ($from, {{…}}), so it replays on recordedClient.

turns.content: I'll start by finding the NEAR validator network and checking what's already published.
There's an existing flower with this title, but you asked for a fresh one — so I'll build a new analysis. Getting the snapshot:
Now I'll propose the spec with backers as segments:

interpretation.summary: NEAR's stake is spread across 371 seated validators and pools holding 593.4M NEAR, but not evenly: the top 9 could together pass a third of stake, and the largest pool (astro-stakers) holds 5.6%. The flower splits each pool's bar by who backs it: other delegators, accounts with 1M+ NEAR, liquid-staking contracts and lockups. Most backing is small delegators; a few pools are dominated by liquid-staking or large holders.

power_means.claim: Power in NEAR's validator set is stake delegated to a pool, which decides blocks and endorsements this epoch.
Stake is concentrated: HHI 0.021 and Gini 0.836 across the 371 included validators, with the top 10 holding 36.2%.

mappings.why: Square root of each validator's share of epoch stake; larger bars mean more stake, compressed so small pools stay visible.
Share of stake this epoch, in a log band of at most 2x.
Each pool's bar is split by backer class: other delegators, 1M+ NEAR accounts, liquid-staking contracts, lockups.
Kind of account, so pools and liquid-staking contracts read differently.
Solid only for self-declared or verified names such as astrostakers.com; dashed for inferred, none for unknown.
Largest stake first, clockwise from the top.

conflicts: Stake is one kind of power; governance weight, validator reputation and off-chain operators of the named pools are others. This flower draws stake and its backers only.
unknowns: Liquid-staking contracts (Meta Pool, LiNEAR) appear as delegators, but their own token holders are not listed, so who ultimately backs those stakes is unknown.
424 idle pools were not crawled; ~6,656 delegation records and their delegators are missing.
Lockup owners were not resolved, so lockup backing is attributed to the contract, not a person.
Pool identities are self-declared in pool-details.near; a name is not proof of control.
Delegations under 1,000 NEAR are folded into one row per pool and backer class, so individual small delegators are not pictured.
inferred: Grouping several pools with similar names (bitwise_1, bitwise_2; cnear-1/2/3; figment and ledgerbyfigment) into one operator would be an inference; this flower does not do it.
